test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**There is an underlined segment in the given sentence. Select the most appropriate option to substitute the segment. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required’.**

In spite of her long absence from college, __she expects to do__ better in the exams than her friends.

options.text: but still she expects to do

solution:
The correct answer is: **No substitution required**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In spite of denotes **although or even though**
 
• According to the given sentence, the correct form of tense to be used is 'Present Tense'
 
• In the given sentence **'she' **is the third person singular, therefore '**expects'** is used.

Hence the given sentence is both **grammatically and conceptually correct.**

**Note- Has expected** will be used in the passive form which is not correct according to the given sentence.
